mapper.select: SELECT cm_id, cm_sender_id, cm_text_body FROM chat_message WHERE cm_chat_room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY cm_created_at, cm_id
SELECT cr_id, cr_product_id, cr_seller_id, cr_buyer_id FROM chat_room WHERE cr_seller_id = #{userId} OR cr_buyer_id = #{userId} ORDER BY cr_created_at DESC, cr_id DESC
SELECT cr_id, cr_product_id, cr_seller_id, cr_buyer_id FROM chat_room WHERE cr_id = #{roomId} AND (cr_seller_id = #{userId} OR cr_buyer_id = #{userId})
